record.source_episode: Approved FAA context plus supervised development diagnosis2026-09-23
record.trigger: A selected requirements section refers to external quantity tables, environmental assumptions, definitions or diagrams.
record.principle: Preserve the source dependencies of a requirements passage during English preparation. Include exact approved context and diagram transcription with provenance for review; distinguish environmental premises from guarantees that components must establish.
record.semantic_choice: Do not treat a section excerpt as a complete specification when it relies on earlier definitions or assumptions. Restore existing source facts before inventing repair assumptions or relaxing domains.
record.structural_placement: Attach premises to the responsible system boundary and trace producer guarantees and consumer assumptions. Keep diagram transcription separate from proposed interpretations of ambiguous guards.
record.repair_gate: Review source fidelity and scope; check assumption satisfiability and producer discharge; re-run affected behavioral and engineering gates. Source supplementation itself is not verification.
prerequisites: Human review before a revised preparation replaces selected English
exclusions: Evaluator worked answers disguised as shared context
Silent priority decisions for ambiguous state diagrams
Accepting missing golden contracts as requirement waiver

parameters.name: source_dependencies
parameters.constraints: Exact source and line or figure/page identity; no unstated premises

parameters.name: assumption_owner
parameters.constraints: Trace premise discharge separately from consumer proof

target_compatibility: Reviewed English preparation for selected KSU HAMR workflow
preserved_obligations: Existing approved preparation and evidence history

counterexample.scenario: A regulator excerpt copies valid desired bounds but omits earlier external-range and ordering assumptions. Broad internal domains then admit reversed ranges or invalid copy-domain witnesses.
counterexample.expected_difference: Restore existing source premises and prove their boundary support; do not widen output ranges, clamp values or silently assume arbitrary ordering.

record.notes: Session-assistant curated draft from approved FAA context and supervised development feedback. No paid model extraction. Local solver checks are manually transcribed diagnostics, not independent rule validation. No confidence value invented.
source_english_patterns: the monitored variables are shown in table
positive_paraphrases: include referenced boundary conditions in the prepared requirements
misleading_near_matches: unconstrained inputs mean the output domain should be widened

semantic_roles.condition: selected passage depends on other approved source material
semantic_roles.effect: reviewed dependency-complete English with explicit premise ownership
semantic_roles.quantification: each referenced dependency relevant to the selected target
semantic_roles.temporal_scope: before formalization; reconsider after source amendment
semantic_roles.state_dependency: diagram state semantics preserved, ambiguity exposed
semantic_roles.units_and_boundaries: preserve source units, ranges and strict inequalities

record.formal_output_pattern: Source obligation -> referenced definitions/assumptions/figures -> reviewed English -> owner and assumption-discharge evidence -> behavioral gates.
allowed_edit_scope: new pending preparation and draft meta-rule only
required_baseline: Approved original source context and selected preparation

provenance.scope: Supervised preparation repair pattern; unvalidated draft, not a published release
